title: Agent memory pipelines are in Beta
body: Agent memory pipelines are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). A memory pipeline connects a session store to a memory store. Each run uses an LLM to distill durable facts, preferences, and decisions from stored conversations into memory entries that your agent recalls in later conversations. You can run a pipeline on demand or about every 24 hours. See [Agent memory pipelines](/aws/en/agents/agent-memory/memory-pipelines).
